title: At the table
subtitle: Serving and pairing Nebbiolo
objectives: Choose the right Nebbiolo for the occasion

steps.title: Piedmont's table
steps.body: Nebbiolo suits Piedmont's rich food: tajarin pasta with butter and white truffle, brasato al Barolo, beef braised in Barolo, roast game, and aged cheeses like Castelmagno. Truffle and Nebbiolo share earthy aromas. Its tannin and acidity cut through richness.

steps.title: Service
steps.body: Serve at 17 to 18 degrees in a large glass. Decant young wines for hours. Langhe Nebbiolo can be drunk young, within five years. Barbaresco often from 7 to 20 years, Barolo from 10 to 30 years or more. Choose the younger styles for everyday meals.

steps.prompt: Which dish is a Piedmont classic with Barolo?

steps.body: White truffles from Alba are in season from October to December, the same time Nebbiolo is harvested. That's no coincidence for Piedmont's cooking.

steps.explanation: Delicate fish would clash with its tannin.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Nebbiolo suits truffle, braised beef and aged cheese
Serve at 17 to 18 degrees in a large glass
Choose Langhe Nebbiolo for youth, Barolo for patience
